hypothesis: Adding variadic constructor options preserves zero-argument invocation but changes function type assignability. New generic and option names have distinct availability, while the existing retry-with-timer function type may stay compatible. Compile real owned consumers rather than infer complete backward compatibility from a source signature alone.
